eps.o: The US Army summons bounty hunter Bass Reeves to Fort Hope to hire him for one last job: retrieve a missing scientist — and stop a second Civil War.

eps.t: A Good Way to Catch a Bullet
eps.o: Now saddled with an unexpected sidekick, Bass rides into the Badlands to find Bully Shaw and reconnects with an old friend.
An electrifying clash with the Holy People leaves Bass in shock and in need of repair. Dana learns the truth about Bass' traumatic past.
Tensions boil over on the train to Tuskaheegee, stirring core memories from Dana's childhood and pulling Bass into a fateful confrontation.

eps.t: I Do What I Have to Do to Survive
eps.o: Bass begs Ahni to let go of her anger as crowds gather in the City of Tomorrow, where General Rivenbark unveils the ultimate weapon.

eps.t: If You Want a Country, You Have to Kill for It
eps.o: With innocent lives on the line, the Colossus takes the fight to Central City — with Bass and his God Arm close behind.
